author: SamJC
quote:
A truly inspirational game. A nod to a time when the gaming industry wanted the user to feel and be challenged. When the right thing to do was the right thing. 
Saving the world, believing in the future and giving hope to the hopeless. 
Well done Nintendo - 10/10
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: SamJC
quote: This is just the most polished of today’s modern expectations. It ticks boxes and makes you say “wow”, instead of really making you say why. Inspiration and adventure is what truly inspires us about gaming. Impressive games aren’t what truly hook me anymore. I want heart and soul. What would I want my kids to discover and spending their lives and friendships built on? Not this. I’ll stick with the indie games that care about the player, not the game.
